jab aasman phatt parray ga ,
aur woh apney perwerdigar ka hukum sunn ker maan ley ga , aur uss per lazim hai kay yehi keray ,
aur jab zameen ko kheench diya jaye ga ,
aur uss kay andar jo kuch hai woh ussay bahir phenk dey gi aur khaali hojaye gi ,
aur woh apney perwerdigar ka hukum sunn ker maan ley gi , aur uss per lazim hai kay yehi keray , ( uss waqt insan ko apna anjam maloom hojaye ga )
aey insan ! tu apney perwerdigar kay paas phonchney tak musalsal kissi mehnat mein laga rahey ga , yahan tak kay uss say jaa milay ga .
phir jiss shaks ko uss ka aemal nama uss kay dayen haath mein diya jaye ga ,
uss say to aasaan hisab liya jaye ga ,
aur woh apney ghar walon kay paas khushi manata huwa wapis aaye ga ,
lekin woh shaks jiss ko uss ka aemal nama uss ki pusht kay peechay say diya jaye ga ,
woh moat ko pukaray ga ,
aur bharakti hoi aag mein dakhil hoga ,
pehlay woh apney ghar walon kay darmiyan boht khush rehta tha ,
uss ney yeh samajh rakha tha kay woh kabhi palat ker ( Allah kay samney ) nahi jaye ga ,
bhala kiyon nahi-? uss ka perwerdigar ussay yaqeeni tor per dekh raha tha .
abb mein qasam khata hun shafaq ki ,
aur raat ki aur unn tamam cheezon ki jinhen woh samett ley ,
aur chaand ki jab woh bhar ko poora hojaye ,
kay tum sabb aik manzil say doosri manzil ki taraf charrhtay jao gay .
phir inn logon  ko kiya hogaya hai kay woh emaan nahi latay-?
aur jab inn kay samney Quran parha jata hai to woh sajda nahi kertay-?
balkay yeh kafir log haq ko jhutlatay hain ,
aur jo kuch yeh jama ker rahey hain , Allah ko khoob maloom hai .
abb tum enhen aik dardnak azab ki khushkhabri suna do .
albatta jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko aisa sawab milay ga jo kabhi khatam nahi hoga .
